title: TEV Mesleki Ortaöğretim Bursu
description: Türk Eğitim Vakfı's need-based monthly scholarship for students facing financial hardship despite strong academic potential, restricted to those enrolled in a vocational/technical Anadolu high school, a fine-arts high school, a sports high school, or a health high school in Turkey -- not open to students at general academic high schools. Pays 3,500 TL/month from October through June (9 months). Applications are reviewed on financial need and academic standing; students already enrolled in open/distance education or a paid program, or with a disciplinary record or academic-continuity interruption, are excluded per the source page.
citizenship_restrictions: T.C. vatandaşı (Turkish citizen) -- stated directly on the official page.
residency_restrictions: Must be enrolled at a vocational/technical Anadolu, fine-arts, sports, or health high school in Turkey; general academic (non-vocational) high school students are not eligible for this specific TEV programme.
current_cycle_label: 2026-2027 başvuruları 1 Eylül - 8 Ekim 2026 arası açık (confirmed on the official page during this research pass).
verification_status: Verified - official tev.org.tr page fetched and read directly; eligibility (school type), application window (1 Eylül-8 Ekim 2026), and monthly amount (3,500 TL) all quoted from the page itself. Age eligibility mentioned in secondary sources (under 18) was NOT confirmed on the official page itself, so left null rather than asserted from an unverified source.

title: Vakıflar Genel Müdürlüğü Ortaöğrenim Bursu
organization: T.C. Vakıflar Genel Müdürlüğü (General Directorate of Foundations, Government of Türkiye)
description: A Turkish government need-based scholarship for primary, middle, and high school students who are Turkish citizens, paid over 9 months (October-June). Excludes students at private schools, students in open/distance-education programmes, students with a sibling already receiving this same aid, students already receiving another public scholarship or educational grant, and students already receiving VGM's own separate needy-persons stipend -- confirmed via the current programme announcement. As of this research pass the 2026-2027 application window has not yet been published by VGM; last cycle (2025-2026) ran October 1-15.
citizenship_restrictions: T.C. vatandaşı (Turkish citizen) -- stated on the official programme page.
residency_restrictions: Excludes students enrolled at private schools, in open/distance education, with a sibling already receiving this same VGM aid, already receiving another public scholarship, or already receiving VGM's separate needy-persons stipend.
current_cycle_label: 2026-2027 başvuru takvimi VGM tarafından henüz açıklanmadı (2026-2027 application calendar not yet announced by VGM as of this research pass, 2026-09-03) -- last cycle (2025-2026) ran October 1-15, 2025, now past.
verification_status: Verified - official vgm.gov.tr programme page and its most recent cycle announcement both fetched and read directly; eligible student categories (ilköğretim/ortaöğretim/lise) and last cycle's now-past dates are quoted from the pages themselves. The 2026-2027 deadline is explicitly not yet published anywhere on the official site as of this research pass -- left null rather than reusing last cycle's dates, which do not apply to this year.

title: Millfield School Sixth Form Scholarships and Bursaries
description: UK boarding school (Somerset, England) offering Academic, Art, Drama, Music and Sports scholarships for Sixth Form (16+) entry, which parents in genuine financial need can then apply to have augmented by a means-tested bursary (up to 100% fee reduction in exceptional cases) -- a real fee-reduction mechanism, not an honorary-only award. The official page does not state whether overseas/international families are eligible for the bursary specifically -- it directs pupils living overseas to contact the Admissions department before submitting a scholarship application, which this record treats as an open question rather than an assumed yes or no.
residency_restrictions: Not stated on the official page whether the means-tested bursary (the real-money component, as opposed to the honorary scholarship title) is available to overseas/international families -- the school directs overseas applicants to contact Admissions before applying. Left unresolved rather than assumed open or closed.
current_cycle_label: Sixth Form scholarship applications for September 2027 entry close October 7, 2026 (confirmed on the official page during this research pass).
